subject: chemistry
title: Project work
textbookText: 1. Visit an industry of manufacturing sulphuric acid (otherwise, in virtual mode on YouTube). Make a chart of advantages and disadvantages of sulphuric acid in society. (Social, economic, health, etc.) and present in your classroom.
2. Make a chart of the manufacture of ammonia by Haber’s process and sodium hydroxide by diaphragm cell method and submit it to your teacher.
3. Make a table as given below and discuss in classroom
Compounds Ammonia Nitric acid Sulphuric acid Sodium carbonate Sodium hydroxide
